working: Rutherford scattering gives N(θ) ∝ 1/sin⁴(θ/2). The count is very large at small angles and falls steeply as θ increases. Beyond about 90° it flattens to a small, nearly constant value up to 180°. This is the standard NCERT plot: a steep decline from about 10^7 that levels off near 10^2. Option 3 matches this shape; option 2 falls too gradually and stays flat at small angles.
